title: Property: Round-Trip Codec
prompt: Implement both halves of a tiny codec and prove the round-trip property: `decode(encode(v)) == v` for every vector. Encoding: run-length, e.g. {3,3,3,5} -> "3x3,1x5". Decode parses that exact format back. Empty vector encodes to the empty string and decodes back to empty.

tests.name: encode format
tests.hint: Walk the vector, count consecutive equal runs, emit "<count>x<value>" joined with commas.

tests.name: the round-trip property
tests.hint: decode splits on commas, parses "<count>x<value>", and expands each run — round-trip then holds for all inputs including empty.
